body: The European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) has published the Annual Safety Review (ASR) 2026, providing a comprehensive analysis of aviation safety in Europe during 2025 and comparing the results with the previous 10 years. The review provides a detailed picture of accidents, serious incidents and the leading safety risks across the different aviation domains, and is an important data-driven input to the European Safety Risk Management process and the European Plan for Aviation Safety (EPAS).

The overall picture shows that, in almost all domains, the number of fatal accidents and fatalities remained at or below the average for the previous 10 years, suggesting safety performance remained broadly stable or improved in most areas, although results varied between types of operation, underlining the need for continued vigilance and targeted safety action. For the first time, the full review is accompanied by a new six-page Annual Safety Review Summary presenting headline figures and leading safety risks for commercial air transport aeroplanes, rotorcraft and general aviation in a concise and accessible format.
en.summary: EASA has published its Annual Safety Review 2026, a comprehensive analysis of aviation safety in Europe during 2025 compared with the previous 10 years, finding fatal accidents and fatalities at or below the 10-year average in almost all domains.
en.title: EASA publishes Annual Safety Review 2026, finding European safety broadly stable in 2025

body: 歐洲航空安全局發布2026年度安全評鑑，針對2025年歐洲航空安全提出全面分析，並將結果與過去10年比較。評鑑詳細呈現各領域事故、嚴重事件與主要安全風險，是歐洲安全風險管理流程與歐洲航空安全計畫的重要數據基礎。
整體而言，幾乎所有領域的致命事故與死亡人數都維持在過去10年平均值或以下，顯示多數領域安全表現大致穩定或有所改善；但不同營運類型的結果仍有差異，仍需持續警覺並採取針對性安全行動。本次評鑑首度附上全新6頁年度安全評鑑摘要，以簡潔易懂的方式呈現商用航空運輸飛機、旋翼機與通用航空的重點數據與主要安全風險。
zh.summary: 歐洲航空安全局發布2026年度安全評鑑，全面分析2025年歐洲飛安並與過去10年比較；多數領域致命事故與死亡人數維持在過去10年平均值或以下，表現大致穩定或改善，並首度附上6頁摘要。
zh.title: EASA發布2026年度安全評鑑：歐洲2025年飛安表現大致穩定
